# Claims Assessment Memo

## Summary

Wayfarer Fintech Ltd (policy CC-1407) reported the theft of a camera body and a lens from an unlocked desk at its office on Harbour Lane. The items were in a shared area and were not in a locked container. The claim falls within the theft cover in clause 4.2, but exclusion 7.1 (unattended property) applies. **Decision: not covered.**

## Facts

- The insured is Wayfarer Fintech Ltd, under policy CC-1407. [notice of loss]
- The loss was reported on 10 September 2026. [notice of loss]
- The reported loss is theft of a camera body and lens from an unlocked desk at the insured's office on Harbour Lane. [notice of loss]
- The theft was reported to the police under reference CR/2026/4143, in a report dated 12 September 2026 made by Wayfarer Fintech Ltd. [police report]
- The items listed in the police report are a camera body and a lens. [police report]
- The police report records that the items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container. [police report]
- The file does not record that the room was locked. The only description of the storage is an unlocked desk. [notice of loss] [police report]
- The camera body is invoiced at 3,307 dollars (Beacon Office Supply). [invoice 1]
- The lens is invoiced at 2,201 dollars (Crane & Sons Electronics). [invoice 2]
- The date of the theft is not stated in the file. [notice of loss] [police report]
- The policy schedule is not in the file, so the named premises and any excess are not shown.

## Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.2 covers loss of business contents caused by theft at the premises named in the schedule, and at other premises in the insured's custody. The loss is theft of business contents from the insured's office [notice of loss]. The schedule is not in the file, so I have not confirmed that Harbour Lane is a named premises. This does not change the outcome, because the claim fails on exclusion 7.1 either way.

**Other cover clauses.**
- Clause 4.5 (transit) does not apply. The file records no carrying of the items between premises. [notice of loss] [police report]
- Clause 4.7 (escape of water) does not apply. No water damage is reported. [notice of loss]
- Clause 4.9 (electrical surge) does not apply. No surge is reported. [notice of loss]

**Exclusions.**
- **Clause 7.1 (unattended property): applies.** This clause excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room at the time. The camera body and lens are portable equipment. They were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report]. The theft was from an unlocked desk [notice of loss]. The file records no locked room. The exception is therefore not met.
- **Clause 7.5 (unproven loss): not relied on.** This clause excludes theft not reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 12 September 2026 [police report], and the notice of loss is dated 10 September 2026 [notice of loss]. The file does not give the date of the theft, so the seven-day period cannot be measured from the file. The exclusion is not applied.
- **Clause 7.3 (wear and tear): does not apply.** The loss is theft, not gradual deterioration. [notice of loss]

## Decision

**Not covered.** The loss falls within the theft cover in clause 4.2, but it is excluded by clause 7.1. The items were in a shared area, not in a locked container, and the file records no locked room [police report] [notice of loss].

## Reserve

Under clause 9.1, the reserve is the sum of the invoices less any excess shown in the schedule. The invoices total 5,508 dollars (3,307 dollars [invoice 1] plus 2,201 dollars [invoice 2]). No schedule is in the file, so no excess is shown and none applies under clause 9.1.

**Reserve: 5,508 dollars.**

This is the figure the clause produces. Because the decision above is not covered, it represents the exposure only if the decision is revised, for example if evidence emerges that the items were in a locked room. The schedule should be obtained to confirm the named premises and the excess position.
